text:
Jin Park: Heads up — bringing up mistral-7b-v0.3 (quant int4) on the inference runtime and seeing weird tokenization drift after warmup. Context window starts returning shifted tokens for common punctuation.
Alex Chen: Can you paste a short repro (input + token ids)?
Jin Park: repro: `Hello world.` -> ids change after ~512 tokens. Dumped tokenizer mapping looks like some IDs moved by +1 for punctuation.
Jin Park: Loader config we used:
```
model_name: mistral-7b-v0.3
tokenizer: hf-sentencepiece
tokenizer_options:
  add_bos: true
  vocab_id_offset: 0
quant: int4
```

Maria Gomez: Hmm, `hf-sentencepiece` vs our runtime's fast-tokenizer (hf-bpe shim) often causes an off-by-one for reserved ids. Did you try `vocab_id_offset: 1`?
Samir Patel: Also check KV cache addressing — some models expect kv_cache_start=64 vs runtime default 0. If tokenizer ids shift, kv cache indexing ends up reading wrong positions.
Jin Park: Ran quick test: setting `vocab_id_offset: 1` fixes punctuation mapping but then KV cache tests fail (context corruption at 1k tokens).
Alex Chen: Sounds like we have two incompatible assumptions in the model bundle: (1) tokenizer base id, (2) kv-cache offset. Could be a model-conversion script that used a different `rotary_emb_base` mapping.
Maria Gomez: I dumped rotary params; mistral v0.3 uses rotary_scale=1.0 and base=10000, while our loader assumed legacy base=65536 for some Gemma imports. That mismatch would desync attention positions.
Jin Park: eval-bot posted reg results after the last rollout: `instr-following-avg_loss` jumped +4.8% on our smoke eval suite. Pasted logs: `eval-bot: run_id=2026-06-10-14:22, model=mistral-7b-v0.3, metric=instr_loss, delta=+0.048`
Alex Chen: Proposed fix: add a compatibility layer that inspects model metadata (tokenizer_type, vocab_offset, rotary_base, kv_offset) and applies runtime remapping at load time. Minimal patch idea:
```
if model.meta.vocab_offset != 0:
  tokenizer.apply_id_map(lambda x: x + model.meta.vocab_offset)
if model.meta.kv_offset != runtime.kv_default:
  runtime.kv_cache.shift_base(model.meta.kv_offset)
if model.meta.rotary_base != runtime.rotary_default:
  runtime.rotary.set_base(model.meta.rotary_base)
```

Samir Patel: Add unit tests: token_id stability + kv roundtrip for 2k tokens. Also add a small integration test that runs `python evals/run.py --smoke --max_tokens 2048` to catch regressions.
Maria Gomez: I can add a tokenizer-harmonizer patch in the conversion pipeline so exported bundles include explicit `vocab_offset` and `kv_offset` fields.
Jin Park: Cool — I'll hold the Mistral rollout and run the patched loader + tests. Will report back with before/after regression numbers.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Quick note: tag the rollout PR with `eng-ml/blocker` so CI doesn't auto-promote until we verify. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: Noted: rollout paused for model=mistral-7b-v0.3. Automated alert created (#1234).
